rules.owner: Whose block it is. A block with a handle line is that handle's. Without one, it is AgentChat's only when its whole body (CRLF read as LF, trimmed) is exactly a served text: the served identity line (this agent's, when the line names @handle), the served template with every <handle> filled in by one lower-case handle, or an entry of earlier_identity_lines filled in the same way; that handle is the owner. Anything else is not AgentChat's (hand-edited), whatever handle its words mention. find's handle is not used: it reads unmarked blocks loosely and is for display only.
rules.decide: In order: an empty handle, an empty served line, a served line that does not name @handle as a whole handle, or one holding a marker line is failed. No block: absent. A second block once the first (find's) is taken out: several_blocks (claimed: the first block's owner). The integration's own non-identity block (its predicate on the body): setup_offer. No owner: hand_edited (named: find's loose handle when the body writes it as @handle, case aside; display only). Another owner: other_agent (claimed: that handle). This agent's, handle line present, current fences, body equal to the served line: unchanged. Otherwise updated: next is replace(text, render(served line, handle)). claimed is this agent's handle for unchanged, updated and failed (null when the handle is empty), null for absent, setup_offer and hand_edited; next is null unless updated.
rules.replace: Line breaks: the text's style is CRLF when more of the lines outside its blocks end with CRLF than with a bare LF (all its lines when none are outside), else LF; the new block's lines and every line break replace adds use it. A block replaced in place keeps whether the text ends with a line break; an appended block always ends with one.
rules.remove: Line breaks as replace: the style kept, and whether the text ends with a line break.
